number_line: Over two tonnes, worth a hundred and fifty-seven million euros.
gotcha: In heavy seas, Army Rangers dropped onto the ship from a helicopter.
person_line: Captain Soheil Jelveh had faked an emergency and been airlifted off.
consequence_line: His lawyer said captain in name only. The court said he knew: seventeen and a half years.
person_first: He jumped ship the day before the Rangers landed.
